messages.author: 98e634f62928ae87
messages.subject: Proposal for GSoC2013: "rapport" and "pander" packages
parts:
Dear All,

I have just uploaded a proposal about some of our packages at http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013:rapport and I would be really happy if the R Community would find these packages worth to list among this year's proposed projects.

To be honest, I was very busy with reading all the docs about how to apply to GSoC individually as an organization when I have found the central GSoC hub on the R wiki site, and came to know about this great idea so that R related projects could apply for GSoC together.

Please let me know if my proposal would fit the main goals of the collective so that I could also update the table at the bottom of the http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013 page and if there would be anything more I should do now, or if I should rather try to apply for GSoC separately.

I already have a proposed student who could help with the listed ideas, but of course I would be very happy to see any assistance in the projects.

Best,
Gergely

messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: Re: Proposal for GSoC2013: "rapport" and "pander" packages
parts:
Gergely,

Thanks for posting your project idea.  We're in the process of finalizing the organization application, and are hopeful that the R project will be chosen again.

I took a look at your posted project idea, and I'd like to suggest that you provide more guidance to a student.  What, really are your project priorities?  How will accomplishing these priorities serve the larger R community?  Can you post examples of current versus desired functionality?  Basically, help both a prospective student and other R mentors understand what it is you want. Right now, from your 'project ideas' section, I don't really have a good idea of what  you're hoping a student would accomplish during the summer.  

I think a little more work on the project idea will pay off in better student applications.

Regards,

Brian

messages.subject: Re: Proposal for GSoC2013: "rapport" and "pander" packages
parts:
You are absolutely right, thank you very much for the valuable feedback.

Unfortunately I tried to add too many separate ideas, and was rather brainstorming in the "project ideas" section to attract more interest it seems - instead of writing up a few well described major areas to be addressed during the summer. Lesson learnt, I will work on the proposal in the next few days and will also update the wiki page soon.

Thank you, again, Brian!

Best,
Gergely

messages.subject: Re: Proposal for GSoC2013: "rapport" and "pander" packages
parts:
Dear All,

I have updated the proposal about "rapport: statistical report templates" [1] based on Brian's highly appreciated comment. Thank you very much again!
It was really useful even for me to rank the ideas in order of importance and also to rough out what could be done in 2-3 months.

Based on the instructions above the main project ideas table [2], I have added this new proposal to the list. Please let me know if it was a smart move :)

And as I have already got in touch with a Hungarian student who had worked on the project a bit, I have also added him as an "interested student", but of course I would be more then happy to see anyone else's help in the project - if my idea would win the support of the GSoC program.

Best,
Gergely

  [1] http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013:rapport
  [2] http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013
